statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
Cardiac event monitoring CPT 93271 was billed
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service was denied because it is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
